remarks: Condominium Valencia home with a patio overlooking The Valencia golf course with a beautifully maintained interior. The parking is always nice when people come to visit and easy to access. The master bedroom overlooks the golf course and has a recently upgraded bathroom with a spacious walk-in closet. Additional practical features include a laundry unit inside and a carport located directly in front.
